text:
incident-bot: PAGER: [P1] High 5xx rate detected for cluster: inference-api-prod. 5xx spike ~18% over baseline for the last 2m, p50 latency up 2x. Paging oncall(s): @sasha.ongcall, @jamie-sre. See alert: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/alerts/inf-api

sasha.ongcall: on it. ack. looking at grafana now, pulling up envoy stats and recent LB config pushes.

jamie-sre: I'll grab the first pass of the routing and retry policies. can someone paste the last envoy config commit id?

alex-platform: last LB config change was rolled 2026-03-14T02:05:12Z by infra-ci (commit f2c9b7). It added a per-route retry policy and relaxed circuit breaker thresholds for the generation route.

irina-support: support sees a handful of customers reporting timed out requests to /v1/generate — ticket examples: #4523, #4527. Customers report 504s and gateway errors. Not all requests, but high ratio on heavy prompt traffic.

sasha.ongcall: digging into envoy /stats: route_gen.upstream_cx_connect_fail > normal, upstream_rq_5xx increased. Also see upstream_rq_pending_retries spike. This looks like retry amplification + backend overload.

jamie-sre: that matches the config change — retries were set to 2 with per-try timeout 3s and retry-on: 5xx,connect-failure,gateway-error. If backend is overloaded, retries will amplify error volume.

mike-dev: can we throttle/remove retries for the generation route as a hotfix? also we might need to tighten circuit breaker (max connections) to shed load.

alex-platform: I can apply a config patch to set retries to 0 on route "generation" and restore cb to previous thresholds. prepping patch now.

sasha.ongcall: while you're doing that, add a host-level route weight shift to favor the stable variant (gen-v1-fallback) so we don't hit the overloaded pool. Also enable 429 backpressure?

alex-platform: applying patch. command: ```kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: envoy-routes
data:
  generation_route: |
    retries: 0
    retry_on: ""
    per_try_timeout_ms: 0
    circuit_breakers:
      max_connections: 1000
      max_pending_requests: 200
EOF
```

deploy-bot: config-change: envoy-routes updated (commit d3b4c6) by alex-platform. Rolling config to inference-api-prod nodes (3/3).

jamie-sre: once applied, we should watch for immediate drop in retry-related counters and 5xx. also watch tail latency. Preparing quick smoke: ```for host in $(kubectl get pods -l app=inference-api -o name); do kubectl exec $host -- curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" https://$host.internal/v1/health; done```

sasha.ongcall: config rolled. I see upstream_rq_pending_retries back to baseline and upstream_rq_5xx decreasing. p90 latency still elevated but dropping.

irina-support: customer tickets show reduced 504 frequency from 40% of incidents to ~10% in last 10 minutes. passing initial updates to customers. :thumbsup:

mike-dev: also scaled backend pool by +2 replicas as a precaution (scaledetector: autoscaler unable to react quickly under retry-amplified load).

alex-platform: backend scale up done. new pods are warm.

jamie-sre: good. next steps: create postmortem checklist, remove risky retry defaults from upcoming rollout, and add canary monitoring for per-route retry amplification. I'll own the postmortem.

sasha.ongcall: handing off to mike-dev for the longer-term remediation and rollout plan, I need to sign off on an unrelated paging rotation. mike, please own follow-ups and ensure rollback gating in CI for any retry/cb changes.

mike-dev: taking over. I'll coordinate with infra to add automated guardrails: fail-closed retry defaults, route-level circuit breaker autoscaling, and an alert for retry amplification (upstream_rq_pending_retries > X). Will open tickets and assign owners.

irina-support: leaving notes for impacted customers, will monitor and escalate if anything changes.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation applied (retries disabled, cb tightened, backend scaled). Severity downgraded from P1 -> P2, continued monitoring for 30m.

jamie-sre: logging this thread id in the incident tracker and tagging for postmortem. pulling traces/logs for 10m window around spike.

mike-dev: thanks all. will publish a short RCA draft by EOD and schedule a remediation RFC. tagging: @engineering, @platform.

alex-platform: leaving a note in infra changelog: revert retry defaults in next deploy and add explicit canary flag.

sasha.ongcall: confirmed handoff to mike-dev. I am clear. :white_check_mark:

irina-support: closing initial customer notices, will follow-up if any regressions.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (mitigated): last observed spike subsided. Monitor window in progress.
